body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said that, from 6 a.m. on November 14 to 6 a.m. on November 15, it detected eight Chinese naval vessels, three official vessels, and one Chinese military aircraft entering the airspace east of Taiwan. The ministry released the figures in its morning update on Chinese military activity around Taiwan.
The ministry said the armed forces monitored and responded to the activity with assigned aircraft and vessels as well as shore-based missile systems, keeping the situation under close watch.
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry said it detected eight Chinese naval vessels, three official vessels and one military aircraft near Taiwan's eastern airspace over the past 24 hours, and that the armed forces monitored them with aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems.
en.title: Eight Chinese warships and one military aircraft approach Taiwan as armed forces monitor closely

body: 國防部15日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自14日上午6時起至15日上午6時止，偵獲8艘共艦、3艘公務船，以及1架共機進入東部空域。
國防部表示，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.summary: 國防部統計14日上午6時至15日上午6時，偵獲8艘共艦、3艘公務船及1架共機進入東部空域，國軍運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
zh.title: 8艘共艦、1架共機擾台　國軍動用任務機艦與岸置飛彈嚴密監控
